reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two separate bodies of literature: nano-indentation creep studies showing higher activation energy and lattice distortion in related HEAs (P2, P3, P5, P7) and theoretical/experimental work establishing edge dislocation dominance in refractory HEAs (P11, P14, P19, P20, P21, P24, P25). It links these through a new mechanistic chain—lattice distortions promote edge dislocation activity, which enables uniform strain and crack-tip blunting—to predict plastic strain and toughness in the previously unstudied WTaTiVZr alloy, a combination no passage proposes.
